result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly well-designed. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and card clipping in horizontal scroll areas.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right edge with truncated text, though this is expected behavior for a horizontal scroll carousel.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partial card visibility is intentional to hint at scrollability; if not, adjust card widths or padding so text isn't awkwardly cut off.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons appear inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards — the top one has a white circle with dark outline while the bottom one has a dark circle with white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button styling across all cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, hiding its title and details.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but verify sufficient content padding above the bottom navigation bar so cards are not partially obscured on load.
